briefing: Recruit, listen up! When you transmit data to the mainframe, every piece of intel needs a proper identifier. Without it, your signals are just noise, defaulting to 'on' and making your data useless. Radio buttons and checkboxes are critical access points; their 'value' attribute ensures the server knows exactly what you've selected, preventing critical data loss.
objective: Assign precise 'value' attributes to all existing 'radio' and 'checkbox' inputs to ensure clean data transmission.
